name: flat-water-spread-holes
comment: Flow-direction choice (BlockFlowing.getOptimalFlowDirections / calculateFlowCost, BlockFlowing.java:132-218): a two-layer stone platform (y = 59, 60) with the rim at y = 61 and one-deep pits (air at y = 60). Source (0,61,0): pits at (0,60,-2) and (-2,60,0) (cost 1 each, a tie) and (3,60,1) (cost 3), so it flows -x and -z only; source (5,61,-5) with a pit right next to it at (6,60,-5) (cost 0, +x only); and a third source placed at t = 30 at (-5,61,4), into the spreading water, with the pit (-1,60,6) beyond the cost search (depth 4, BlockFlowing.java:160) from it. Water falls into the pits (meta + 8) and stops spreading above a filled pit (BlockFlowing.java:80-86).
